key_insight: RIDAR detects research integrity violations in autonomous research agents and intervenes during execution, reducing violations remaining at task completion by 36.8%.
engineering_relevance: RIDAR offers a framework for adding integrity monitoring and corrective interventions to automated scientific workflows.
method: Define 14 research integrity violation types spanning the research lifecycle in the RIVT taxonomy.
Use RIDAR-post-hoc to detect violations in recorded agent trajectories.
Use RIDAR-runtime to dynamically detect and correct violations during execution.
evidence_signal: RIDAR-post-hoc achieved 85.2% F1 on 60 expert-annotated RIV-Gold trajectories and detected 3,964 violations in 99.7% of 300 RIV-Wild trajectories across 50 research tasks.
watch_item: Runtime intervention reduces but does not eliminate violations; detection errors and intervention overhead warrant evaluation before deployment.
paper_title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
